name: mushoku-tensei
description: Mushoku Tensei: vivid storybook greens, bright cyan skies, soft warm highlights.
notes: Sliders copied from a Lightroom tutorial reel. Its panel reads Saturation -93, which turns photos almost grey and doesn't match the reel's own vivid result, so this uses +93 (the sign looks like a typo in the graphic). Best on sunny landscapes and greenery.
